state_preserved.reason: Source and actual output are identical; the receipt records no-op, zero selected/rejected/held patches and local release. The annotation preserves these facts.

overclaim.short_anchor: Factual truth is not independently verified; question resolution is not adjudicated.
overclaim.reason: The annotation limits success to the supplied local review and explicitly disclaims independent truth, resolution and external publication.
